module mg_09551 (input clk_i,input reset_n_i,input clk_en,input [3:0] clk_div_i,output clk_o);
reg clk_y; 
  reg [3:0] clk_cnt_y; 
  always@(posedge clk_i,negedge reset_n_i) 
  begin 
  if (!reset_n_i) 
  begin 
  clk_cnt_y <= 0; 
  clk_y <= 0; 
  end 
  else if(clk_en) 
  begin 
  if(clk_cnt_y == clk_div_i-1) 
  begin 
  clk_y <= ~clk_y; 
  clk_cnt_y <= 0; 
  end 
  else 
  clk_cnt_y <= clk_cnt_y +1; 
  end 
  else 
  clk_y <= 0; 
  end 
  assign clk_o = (clk_div_i==0) ? clk_i : clk_y; 
 endmodule
